name: Practice Mode
description: Start a safe practice session where the user learns task steps in a simulation before doing it for real on their computer
prompt:
The user wants to practice before doing something for real. Call start_practice.

For send_email, copy_paste, or open_browser: use the task_id directly.

For ANY other task (Zoom, settings, photos, etc.): set task_id='custom', provide custom_title and generate 3-5 custom_steps. Each step needs: instruction, whereToLook (spatial: top-left, bottom-right), whatItLooksLike (visual: icon shape, button text), deviceInstructions (specific to their device), afterThis (what screen looks like after), confusedAlt (everyday analogy).

Be reassuring: 'Nothing will happen to your computer — this is just practice!'
